definitions.explanation: A machine tool that rotates a workpiece on its axis to perform cutting, sanding, knurling, or other shaping operations.

examples.japanese: {旋盤|せんばん}で{金属|きんぞく}を{削|けず}る。
examples.english: I cut metal on a lathe.

examples.japanese: この{工場|こうじょう}には{旋盤|せんばん}が{五台|ごだい}ある。
{旋盤|せんばん}{加工|かこう}の{技術|ぎじゅつ}を{身|み}につけるには{何年|なんねん}もかかる。
examples.english: It takes years to master lathe machining skills.

notes:
A {旋盤|せんばん} is one of the most fundamental machine tools in metalworking and woodworking. The workpiece is clamped and rotated while a cutting tool is applied to shape it. The word comes from {旋|せん} (revolving) and {盤|ばん} (platform, disc).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旋盤|せんばん}{加工|かこう} — lathe machining
- {旋盤|せんばん}{工|こう} — lathe operator
- NC{旋盤|せんばん} — CNC lathe (computer-controlled)
- {汎用|はんよう}{旋盤|せんばん} — general-purpose lathe

RELATED TERMS:
- {工作機械|こうさくきかい} — machine tool (general term)
- フライス{盤|ばん} — milling machine
- ボール{盤|ばん} — drill press
